title: Content Platform Engineering
shortDescription: Schema-driven CMS architectures that editors love and developers can query with confidence.

children.text: I build headless content platforms where structured authoring, type-safe data access, and real-time updates work together — not as an afterthought. From custom Sanity schemas to live GROQ reads and presentation-mode preview, I own the full content layer.

features: Content modeling and schema design (singletons, references, filtered views)
GROQ query architecture with defineQuery and type-safe server reads
Sanity Studio customization for non-technical editors
Real-time content sync via websocket subscriptions
Draft mode and visual editing for publish-with-confidence workflows
deliverables: Custom document schemas and Studio configuration
GROQ query layer with typed server reads

title: AI Product Integration
shortDescription: Agentic AI features grounded in live data, with guardrails that actually ship to production.

children.text: I design multi-agent workflows with topic filtering, moderation, live context injection, and production infrastructure. The AI Portfolio Twin on this site is the proof: visitors ask real questions, and the system answers from live CMS data with rate limits and thread persistence.

features: OpenAI Agents SDK workflow design (filter, moderate, respond)
Live context injection from CMS, databases, and APIs
Guardrails, topic boundaries, and safe failure modes
Redis-backed session and thread persistence
IP and guest rate limiting for production safety
ChatKit UI integration with configurable conversation tones
deliverables: Multi-agent workflow with moderation and guardrails
Context pipeline pulling live portfolio data
Rate limiting and thread persistence layer

title: Full-Stack Next.js Applications
shortDescription: Production web apps on the App Router — server components, API routes, and deployment-ready architecture.

children.text: I ship full-stack web applications on Next.js with a focus on type safety, performance, and maintainable architecture. This portfolio is the proof — CMS-backed, AI-enabled, and production-deployed on Vercel.

features: Next.js App Router architecture (RSC, streaming, layouts)
Type-safe API route and server action design
Component systems with Tailwind and accessible UI patterns
Performance-conscious rendering strategies
Vercel deployment and environment configuration
deliverables: API routes and server-side data layer

title: API & Data Layer Design
shortDescription: Clean interfaces between your frontend, CMS, AI layer, and external services.

children.text: I design data layers that keep frontend, CMS, and AI systems in sync without brittle coupling. From GROQ reads and REST endpoints to rate-limited public APIs, I build interfaces that are easy to consume and hard to break.

features: RESTful and GraphQL API design
Auth patterns for session, token, and rate-limited endpoints
Server-side data fetching with type-safe queries
Third-party integrations (OpenAI, Upstash Redis, Sanity)
Webhook and event-driven data flows
